bonus.title: Name both organizations
bonus.prompt: One line on the group sheet.

answer.name: Hampshire College
answer.outcome: On April 14, 2026 the college announced it will close after the fall 2026 semester. The statements said it first: customers covered 59 cents of each expense dollar, operations ran on sold savings, and 11.6 months of runway faced 20,418 of debt due within the year.

answer.name: University of Arizona
answer.outcome: A real cash crisis: days of cash fell from 131 to 65 on our page-only measure, and the university reported job losses while it restructured. Still open. The backstop is the public purse, and it came with conditions.

bonus.tone: Keep both factual and restrained. Real people lost jobs and a real college is closing. No humor about the outcome.
